title: Multi-Seed Voronoi AgentCells: Policy-Aware Dispatch with a Containment Guarantee
venue: 1st IEEE Big Data Workshop on Agentic AI for Big Data (AAI-BD 2026), held in conjunction with the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData 2026)
line: A dispatch rule for agent systems: each agent cell owns a set of seeds in embedding space, and authorization is folded into the distance, so no task reaches an unauthorized cell while an authorized one exists.
note: Conditional acceptance, pending final review of the revised submission.

title: Governance-Aware, LLM-Assisted SDTM→ADaM Variable Mapping for Clinical Trial Submissions: A Measured Study on Public CDISC Data
venue: 2nd Workshop on Large Language Models and Big Data Analytics for Health and Medicine (LLMBDA 2026), held in conjunction with the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (IEEE BIBM 2026)
line: A measured study of LLM-assisted SDTM→ADaM variable mapping on the public CDISC Pilot Project.

title: System One: a small trained model that judges dataset requests
line: Reports a small model trained under Brain API to judge which capability of an Agentic Dataset a request is for, among the capabilities policy has already admitted; policy decides what may run, and every decision is recorded with the model's version.

title: Brain API: An Intent-Aware Control Plane for Policy-Governed Agentic Systems
line: Proposes an intent-aware control plane whose central contribution is the decision artifact: a durable, versioned, auditable record of how an intent became an executable plan — which policies applied, which capabilities were evaluated, which alternatives were rejected, and why.

title: A Policy Profile for Croissant: Refusal as a Property of the Dataset
line: Supplies the half of Croissant's data use conditions that no version specifies — how they are evaluated: an additive profile lets a dataset declare the operations it admits and the conditions under which it admits them, over five operators with a complete decision procedure, so a gate decides from the descriptor alone and records what it checked.

title: Is Quantum Ready for Biology? What It Would Take to Put a Quantum Step Inside a Regulated Biopharma Pipeline
venue: IEEE Quantum Week 2026 (QCE26), Toronto — Birds-of-a-Feather session
line: Slides for a Birds-of-a-Feather session on what it would take to put a quantum step inside a regulated biopharmaceutical pipeline: what evidence must accompany a quantum result before a regulated workflow can evaluate it, which biological use cases are credible on noisy intermediate-scale devices and which depend on fault tolerance, and which governance requirements hold in both regimes.

title: Policy-Aware Supervisory Control for Observable Embodied Biomedical Robotic Systems
line: Introduces a policy-aware supervisory architecture for heterogeneous biomedical manipulators in which task intents, lifecycle states, policy decisions, refusal rationale and telemetry traces are first-class runtime artifacts, so an unsafe intent is refused before any planner or driver runs; a simulated plate transfer across a Cartesian pipettor and a 6-DOF arm shows the same intent-level workflow on both, with complete trace reconstruction.
note: In the conference proceedings; IEEE Xplore record pending.

title: Dataset Descriptors for Autonomous and Observable Biomedical Data Pipelines
line: Introduces dataset descriptors as a control-plane abstraction for autonomous biomedical pipelines: structured, versioned specifications that bind a dataset to its policies, permissible actions, and observability requirements, enabling decentralized policy enforcement and real-time auditability in regulated research environments.
note: In the conference proceedings; IEEE Xplore record pending.

title: Agentic Data Services: A Control-Plane Architecture for Adaptive Data Workflows
line: Presents a control-plane architecture for Big Data as a Service that models workflows as adaptive, policy-aware service entities rather than static DAGs, combining a dual-record execution model adapted from pharmaceutical batch manufacturing with workflow-level semantic caching; on clustered workloads the cache reduces backend requests by 81% and median latency by 93%.

title: Agentic Datasets as an Engineering Control Plane
line: Introduces Agentic Datasets as a standalone engineering control-plane abstraction in which datasets are elevated from passive storage artifacts to first-class stateful entities encoding intent, policy, and lifecycle semantics across heterogeneous data-intensive infrastructure.

title: Agentic Datasets as a Control-Plane Abstraction for Data-Intensive Systems
line: DEVS-grounded control-plane formulation of agentic datasets, framing dataset evolution as discrete-event behavior and using discrete-event simulation to evaluate policy, observability, and lifecycle semantics for data-intensive systems.
note: Work-in-progress paper, 4 pp, SCS Digital Library.

title: Tunnelling photoionization in a bichromatic laser field
venue: Journal of Physics B: Atomic, Molecular and Optical Physics
line: Journal article on tunnelling photoionization in a two-color (bichromatic) laser field.
